say:1:1033434001:1.text: Yes, Master Eomir lied to us. But this can't absolve us of our sin.
say:1:1033434001:1.source_cn: 是的，身为贤者的伊米尔确实欺骗了我们，但这并不能洗清我...
say:1:1033434001:1.male: Yes, Master Eomir lied to us. But this can't absolve us of our sin.
say:1:1033434001:1.female: Yes, Master Eomir lied to us. But this can't absolve us of our sin.

say:2:1033434002:1.text: When there's a flood, every drop of the water is equally guilty.
say:2:1033434002:1.source_cn: 洪水席卷时，每一滴被裹挟的水滴都身负罪孽。
say:2:1033434002:1.male: When there's a flood, every drop of the water is equally guilty.
say:2:1033434002:1.female: When there's a flood, every drop of the water is equally guilty.

say:3:1033434003:1.text: It's a fact that the Lucent Tree has been corrupted.
say:3:1033434003:1.source_cn: 流荧树被腐化，这也是无可否认的现实。
say:3:1033434003:1.male: It's a fact that the Lucent Tree has been corrupted.
say:3:1033434003:1.female: It's a fact that the Lucent Tree has been corrupted.

say:4:1033434004:1.text: Misarte... I'm too ashamed to say her name. I dare not pray for her blessing.
say:4:1033434004:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒……我已经没脸再念诵祂名，去乞求祂的庇护。
say:4:1033434004:1.male: Misarte... I'm too ashamed to say her name. I dare not pray for her blessing.
say:4:1033434004:1.female: Misarte... I'm too ashamed to say her name. I dare not pray for her blessing.
